name: Boon of Exquisite Radiance

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Creatures you fell can't rise as Undead, and once per Long Rest one Radiant damage roll uses the maximum on every die.

benefits.name: Final Rest
benefits.summary: A creature you reduce to 0 Hit Points can't become Undead.
benefits.text: A creature you reduce to 0 Hit Points can't be turned into an Undead afterward.

benefits.name: Exquisite Radiance
benefits.summary: Once per Long Rest, every die of one Radiant damage roll counts as its maximum.
benefits.text: Once per Long Rest, when you roll Radiant damage, every die of that roll counts as its highest face. In a fight you arm it (no action) and the next Radiant damage roll you make uses it.
